tested_configuration: Local Tencent HunyuanVideo-I2V checkpoint, 720p, 50 steps, seed 42, 24 fps, same source image and prompt; tested 17, 33, 65 frames in addition to prior 129-frame output.

findings.17_frames: 17/17 decode; intact room, maximum adjacent RGB MAE 2.28/255, frame 8→9 1.17/255
findings.33_frames: 33/33 decode; intact room, maximum adjacent RGB MAE 3.85/255, frame 8→9 2.44/255
findings.65_frames: 65/65 decode; intact room through frame 64, maximum adjacent RGB MAE 4.14/255, frame 8→9 1.80/255, frame 63→64 1.19/255; finite video and latents
findings.129_frames: Prior 129/129 output decodes but abruptly cuts from room to floorboards at frame 8→9, RGB MAE 67.22/255; quality concern remains.
findings.vae_isolation: Same first 5 latent frames decoded alone and as 129-frame prefix using actual VAE checkpoint; maximum prefix MAE 0.0133 on decoder scale, no frame-9 cut.

conclusion: No deterministic implementation bug isolated by these tests; retain 129-frame quality concern. Shorter lengths verify inference and temporal continuity only, not general long-horizon quality or camera-motion adherence.
